region: EU (DE/AT price comparison; Geizhals EU/DE, Alternate DE, Proshop DE, Galaxus DE)
notes: Prices are the lowest listed EU offer on the date shown, not a quote. Stock and price move daily.
The 2026 DRAM/NAND shortage dominates the RAM line; the Gen5 9100 PRO is €264, the same price as the Gen4 990 PRO, so Gen5 is the default where the board has the port.

At EU retail the DDR5-6400 64 GB R-DIMMs found at the snapshot are G.Skill 4×64 (CL36) and 8×64 (CL38) AMD EXPO kits, plus single JEDEC modules: Micron MTC40F2046S1RC64BH1 (2Rx4, CL52, 1.1 V) at €3,279.97 and Kingston KSM64R52BD4 at €3,202.74 (Galaxus). A 1×/2× 6400 start is therefore possible with single modules, at a premium per GB.
GPUs are owned by the user and excluded from platform totals; their replacement value is shown separately.
MCIO/SlimSAS cable prices are estimates; the drives/board are listed prices.

ram_64gb.name: Samsung M321R8GA0PB0-CWM 64 GB DDR5-5600 CL46 2Rx4 ECC RDIMM

ram_64gb_6400_2x.name: Micron MTC40F2046S1RC64BH1 64 GB DDR5-6400 CL52 2Rx4 ECC RDIMM (single module, qty 2)
ram_64gb_6400_2x.vendor: Galaxus DE (single modules, price per module)
ram_64gb_6400_2x.note: 2 modules = 2 channels / 102.4 GB/s, 128 GB; 8 modules = 8 channels / 409.6 GB/s, 512 GB. JEDEC CL52 at 1.1 V, 2Rx4 (40× 4Gb x4), not EXPO. The literal 2×64 6400 start; €51.25/GB.

ram_64gb_6400_4x.name: G.Skill T5 Neo F5-6400R3644E64GQ4-T5N 256 GB (4×64 GB) DDR5-6400 CL36 ECC R-DIMM kit
ram_64gb_6400_4x.vendor: Proshop DE (1-2 months; max 2 per customer)
ram_64gb_6400_4x.note: 4 channels / 204.8 GB/s; CL36-44-44-102 at 1.30 V, AMD EXPO, 4×64 GB R-DIMM. Alternate DE lists €12,269 with 17-25 days. Rank is not printed in the retail listing; verify 2Rx4 on the module/QVL.

ram_64gb_6400_8x.name: G.Skill T5 Neo F5-6400R3848F64GE8-T5N 512 GB (8×64 GB) DDR5-6400 CL38 ECC R-DIMM kit
ram_64gb_6400_8x.note: 8 channels / 409.6 GB/s; CL38-48-48-102 at 1.35 V, AMD EXPO, 8×64 GB, 1 DIMM per channel. The validated 8-DIMM 6400 octa kit; the 4×64 kit is CL36 and not the same bin. Two 4×64 kits cost €24,270.02 and are not guaranteed 6400 at 8 DIMMs. Alternate is notify-only; Proshop lists €27,666.06 with 1-2 months.
